summary: Tillamook County, OR tower built 1955 for Crown Zellerbach, abandoned and gone by 1970; no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.design: 40-foot wooden tower with a live-in cab
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1970 and removed; the register and the Oregon list both mark the site as gone

events.note: 40-foot live-in tower built for Crown Zellerbach Company
Season closed in October 1957; staffed by Mr. and Mrs. Oscar George

evidence.quote: It is located at the 3,600 foot level of the Coast range

evidence.supports: built 1955 by the Crown Zellerbach Company
evidence.quote: 1955: A 40-foot lookout tower constructed by the Crown Zellerbach Company.

evidence.supports: 40-foot tower with a live-in cab built on the site in 1955
evidence.quote: A 40 foot tower with a live-in cab was built on the site in 1955.

evidence.supports: Northwest Fire Patrol association operated it under company supervision
evidence.quote: operated by the Northwest Fire Patrol association under the supervision of Crown Zellerbach corporation

tower had been staffed by Mr. and Mrs. Oscar George

evidence.quote: the lookout will again be manned should the weather picture change and unseasonable dryness set in

evidence.quote: Blue Lake lookout serves as the coordinating station for Crown Zellerbach

evidence.quote: Blue Lake Mountain Tillamook 45.67102 -123.48214 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1795, OR 519

corrections.why: The 1957 report quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page and firelookout.com both spell the company Zellerbach. The register's spelling looks like a typo.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 3,493 ft (1,065 m) and firelookout.com gives 3506 ft. The brief's 1064.7 m follows the register. Elevation is not in facts because the sources disagree.

sources.title: Blue Lake Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Basic facts (built 1955, abandoned and gone 1970) agree across three sources. Staffing rests on one 1957 newspaper item quoted by the Oregon Lookouts page; the original newspaper was not read. No source describes the site today. Brief coordinates match the register. Brief's agency spelling corrected. Elevation disagreement left unresolved.
